summary.text: Nick Gauthier was elected in 2024 to represent the 38th District, which includes Waterford and Montville.

paragraphs.text: A Waterford native, he was previously elected to the Waterford Representative Town Meeting and works for the town's Senior Services Department.
He graduated from Waterford High School and the University of Connecticut and holds a Master of Public Administration degree from the University of New Haven.
